hostname path-lab
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 nameif outside
 security-level 0
 ip address 192.0.2.1 255.255.255.0
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 nameif dmz
 security-level 50
 ip address 10.20.4.1 255.255.255.0
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/2
 nameif inside
 security-level 100
 ip address 10.0.0.1 255.255.255.0
 no shutdown
!
same-security-traffic permit inter-interface
route outside 0 0 192.0.2.254
route outside 203.0.113.0 255.255.255.0 192.0.2.253 5
!
object network WEB
 host 10.20.4.15
 description sanitized published service
!
object network WEB
 nat (dmz,outside) static 198.51.100.15
!
object network IDENTITY-CLIENT
 host 10.0.0.20
!
object network IDENTITY-CLIENT
 nat (inside,outside) static 10.0.0.20
!
access-list OUTSIDE-IN extended permit tcp any host 10.20.4.15 eq 443
access-list OUTSIDE-IN extended deny tcp any host 10.20.4.15 eq 22
access-group OUTSIDE-IN in interface outside
access-list DMZ-IN extended permit ip 10.20.4.0 255.255.255.0 any
access-group DMZ-IN in interface dmz
access-list INSIDE-IN extended permit ip 10.0.0.0 255.255.255.0 any
access-group INSIDE-IN in interface inside
